Maria (CS): Quick heads-up — LuminaHealth pushed their vendor security form deadline out 3 days to 2025-03-22. They specifically asked for KMS usage details and retention policy. @Alex can we produce a short KMS explainer doc?
Alex (Eng): Yup I can draft something. Do we need HSM-level details or just KMS integration flow?
Maria (CS): They asked about key ownership and whether keys can be customer-managed. So HSM integration + how we surface key control in Dedicated/Private.
Ryan (Security): Customer-managed keys = we need to confirm supported modes. For Private we can support customer KMS; for Dedicated hosted we have a workflow but not direct HSM handoff. I'll outline constraints.
Leo (Ops): FYI our standard answer for retention/storage is 90 days for embeddings by default, configurable for enterprise. Do we want to lock that in for LuminaHealth or offer a custom retention addendum?
Tara (Solutions): They mentioned a SOC2 in scope for fintech workflows. We should include a one-pager: "What we share" (evidence), "what remains with customer" (keys, logs), and a short playbook for their legal team. I can make the one-pager if someone drops the tech bullets.
Ken (Product): Suggest we include a matrix: env (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) x KMS options x typical SLAs. That'll make it very easy for sales and legal.
Maria (CS): Good call. I'll book a 15m sync with LuminaHealth for Thursday. Meanwhile Alex + Ryan + Tara: please add draft bullets to this shared sheet by EOD so I can send ahead of call: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1X_example_link
Alex (Eng): Adding KMS flow + sample config snippet now. Snippet: ```kms_mode: customer_managed
region: us-west-2
key_usage: encrypt/decrypt
notes: require IAM role for key access```
Ryan (Security): Adding security caveats. Also flagging that we can't provide HSM serials for hosted nodes; we'll offer attestation + KMS logs export.
Leo (Ops): I'll confirm retention SLA wording and add the standard clause.
Tara (Solutions): One-pager skeleton done, linking in sheet.
Maria (CS): Perfect — last thing: renewal risk flag: this customer is mid-procurement, small pause on security Qs could push renewal timeline. I'll mark as "watch" in Gainsight and include enablement session in renewal playbook. :eyes:
ReminderBot: Reminder: LuminaHealth vendor form deadline in 3 days (2025-03-22).
Ken (Product): Thx team. If we can get the bullets by EOD, I'll turn the matrix into a pdf we can attach to the form responses. :thumbsup:
